subject: environmental-science
title: Biodiversity & Wildlife: Foundations
welcome_lead: Biodiversity is the rich variety of life — and it matters more than you think.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: species, biodiversity, ecosystem.

concepts.def: Variety of living things in an area.

All species living together in a place.

walkthroughs.body_html: Biodiversity includes the number of species, the variety within each species, and the variety of ecosystems.
Rich biodiversity gives us food, clean air, medicine and beauty. It also makes ecosystems tougher when conditions change.
A population is one species in an area. A community is all species together. A habitat is where they live.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between in-situ and ex-situ conservation?
options: They are alternative names for the same approach.
